description: This file defines utility functions and constants related to identifying and handling particular functions and operations in the PyTorch Static Runtime, including recognition of handwritten operations and setup of test values.

methods.name: str func_name_base_str(g: NativeFunctionsGroup | NativeFunctionsViewGroup)
methods.description: Returns the base name of the function or view group, used for identification.

methods.name: bool is_hand_written(g: NativeFunctionsGroup | NativeFunctionsViewGroup)
methods.description: Determines if a given function group is considered a handwritten operation based on its name.

methods.name: None override_test_values(arg_map: dict[str, str], op_name: str, index: int)
methods.description: Sets default test argument expressions for specific operations, aiding in automated testing.

ctags.name: override_test_values
